jobs.title: Silicon Solution Architect & SME
jobs.description:
Job description:

Job Description We are looking for a senior silicon architect to lead customer-facing solutioning for turnkey silicon programs. You will shape winning solutions from concept to production-ready silicon and act as a trusted technical advisor to customer engineering leadership.
͏ What you will do:

•    Lead architecture workshops and technical solutioning for new silicon engagements.
•    Define end-to-end turnkey solutions: SoC/ASIC/chiplet architecture, design, verification, physical design, packaging, validation and production ramp.
•    Own technical scope, estimates and risk in proposals and statements of work.
•    Partner with foundries, EDA/IP and packaging ecosystem partners to build differentiated offerings.
•    Guide delivery teams through architecture reviews and handover.
•    Mentor senior engineers and build reusable solution assets.
͏ What you will bring:

•    20+ years in semiconductor engineering, including 8+ years in SoC/ASIC architecture or technical pre-sales leadership.
•    Strong end-to-end knowledge of the silicon lifecycle, from specification to tape-out to production.
•    Deep expertise in at least two of: compute subsystems, interconnect/NoC, memory subsystems, high-speed I/O (PCIe/CXL/UCIe), low-power design, or chiplets/advanced packaging.
•    Track record of shaping and winning large engineering or turnkey silicon engagements.
•    Advanced-node experience and working knowledge of foundry flows.
•    Executive presence and strong communication with senior customer stakeholders.
•    BS in Electronics/Electrical Engineering; MS or PhD preferred.
͏ Why work at Wipro?

We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of their age, cultural background, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, veteran status, or anything else. If you only meet some of the requirements for this role, that's okay! We value a diverse range of backgrounds & ideas and believe this is fundamental for our future success. So, if you have the curiosity to learn and the willingness to teach what you know, we'd love to hear from you. 
There is a strong focus on building and developing career paths at Wipro as the world around us continues to advance and change, we believe in a high-performance culture that encourages continuous learning.
Wipro has been globally recognized by several organizations for our commitment to sustainability, inclusion, and diversity. Social good is in our DNA, we believe in sustainability for the health of our planet, its inhabitants, and our business. For over 75 years we have operated as a purpose-driven company with an unwavering commitment to our customers and our communities. Energized by what we call the Spirit of Wipro, we commit ourselves to being a catalyst for change – working to build a more just, equitable and sustainable society. Around 66% of Wipro’s economic ownership is pledged towards philanthropic purposes.
All our employees are expected to embody Wipro’s 5-Habits for Success which are: Being Respectful, Being Responsive, Always Communicating, Demonstrate Stewardship, Building Trust.
͏ [[custJD]]
The expected compensation for this role ranges from $200,000.00  to $280,000.00.
Final compensation will depend on various factors, including your geographical location, minimum wage obligations, skills, and relevant experience. Based on the position, the role is also eligible for Wipro’s standard benefits including a full range of medical and dental benefits options, disability insurance, paid time off (inclusive of sick leave), other paid and unpaid leave options.

Applicants are advised that employment in some roles may be conditioned on successful completion of a post-offer drug screening, subject to applicable state law.
Wipro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Applications from veterans and people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer – Human Capital (ED0B288)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a global investment and technology firm to find a senior engineer who will lead practical AI initiatives within its people function. You will work across human capital, product management and software engineering to turn talent-related business needs into useful, governed AI solutions.

The remit combines hands-on prototyping with technical direction. You will build in Python, guide integration into production products, evaluate outcomes and help colleagues make informed choices as models and tooling evolve.

The Role

Identify high-value AI use cases with internal stakeholders and translate them into well-scoped technical solutions.
Design and deliver Python prototypes, then partner with product and engineering teams to integrate successful features.
Evaluate AI tools through user feedback and outcome monitoring, recommending improvements.
Set technical direction across models, tooling, prompt design, retrieval and agentic approaches.
Mentor junior colleagues and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

A bachelor's degree and at least six years' experience across human capital, data science or technology development, including exposure to AI.
Strong Python and data skills, with practical familiarity with LLMs, RAG, agentic architectures and modern AI development tools.
Knowledge of statistical methods; social-science research experience is useful.
Evidence of delivering across ambiguous, cross-functional workstreams and influencing stakeholders.
Management experience is preferred rather than essential.

This could suit an applied AI or data-science leader who enjoys building prototypes while shaping how a people-focused product portfolio adopts AI responsibly.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
jobs.description:
Who We're Looking For

We're looking for Senior and Staff Software Engineers
to join the Agentic Applications team at Supio. You'll build the software behind AI-powered products that legal professionals rely on for high-stakes work, so the code you ship has to be right.

We hire full-stack engineers who've gone deep. You're the person others turn to when a problem gets hard, with a strong backend foundation and the range to work across the rest of the stack. You work autonomously, partner well with product, design, and customers, and take a problem from fuzzy idea to shipped, operating software without waiting to be told what to build. You make good product calls and you leave the code, the system, and the team better than you found them.

We're a small team and the impact is direct. You'll work next to engineers who've built this platform from the ground up, and you'll help shape what we build next.

What You'll Build

You'll build and improve the software behind our AI-powered products, wherever your skills are most needed. You'll:

Own problems end to end. Take ambiguous problems from idea to production: design, build, ship, and operate. You'll drive technical direction in your area and contribute to product decisions.
Build systems that scale and hold up. Design services, interfaces, and data pipelines that stay reliable at high volume and with large, complex datasets.
Work across the stack where it matters. Own work across frontend and backend, with the heaviest lift on the backend.
Build with AI, and build AI-powered features. Use coding agents and AI tools to move faster, and help build, evaluate, and productionize LLM- and agent-driven capabilities with a focus on accuracy and reliability.
Partner closely with product, design, and customer-facing teams. Understand what our users actually need and turn it into the right technical solution.
Raise the bar. Review code thoughtfully, mentor teammates, and build the shared tools and practices that help others move faster. At the Staff level, you'll do this across teams and set technical direction for a broader area.

Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping and operating production systems. Staff candidates should show a track record of leading complex, cross-team technical work.
Full-stack, with depth. Strong software fundamentals and a track record across the stack, with your strongest experience on the backend (services, APIs, data, infrastructure, or systems). You're comfortable owning the frontend too. We don't screen on a specific language.
Production AI experience. You've built with LLMs or agentic systems (RAG, tool use, multi-agent orchestration), you know how to evaluate whether they work, and you use AI coding tools every day.
Ownership and product judgment. You drive work end to end without hand-holding, make good tradeoffs, and partner well with product, design, and customers.
Clear communication, written and in person.

Nice-to-haves

Experience at both startups and larger companies
Experience mentoring engineers or leading teams
Experience with cloud platforms

Compensation

As an early-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits
. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long-term success and upside of the company.

Base Salary by Level and Location

Senior Software Engineer

San Francisco: $190,000 – $240,000 annually
Seattle: $180,000 – $230,000 annually

Staff Software Engineer

San Francisco: $230,000 – $270,000 annually
Seattle: $220,000 – $250,000 annually

This role is open at both the Senior and Staff levels. Final level, and therefore final compensation, is determined during the interview process based on the scope, depth, and impact demonstrated by the candidate. Within each range, placement depends on factors such as qualifications, skills, and experience.
